verdict.rationale: Make's help docs list a "scenario history" feature, which plausibly covers inspecting past executions. That is only a bare heading mention. The error-handling docs cover diagnosing errors and error handlers, but nothing documents re-running a failed execution or resuming from the failing step. missing for 10: documented execution log detail, re-run of failed executions, resume-from-failing-step capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step
